sv.title: Avgjort: Fransk restaurang utses till Lunds bästa
sv.summary: Belle Époque och Broder Jakobs var några av vinnarna när Lunds city awards delades ut på Mejeriet under torsdagskvällen.

en.title: Decided: French restaurant named Lund's best
en.summary: Belle Époque and Broder Jakobs were among the winners when the Lund City Awards were presented at Mejeriet on Thursday evening.
